crossRefs.note: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

translations.web: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.
translations.bsb: “Drink, my lord,” she replied, and she quickly lowered her jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
translations.kjv: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
translations.asv: And she said, Drink, my lord. And she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
